entries.title: Job 38:1
segments: ¶And the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: Who is this who makes the purpose of God dark by words without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Get your strength together like a man of war; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

entries.title: Job 38:4
segments: ¶Where were you when I put the earth on its base? Say, if you have knowledge.

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: By whom were its measures fixed? Say, if you have wisdom; or by whom was the line stretched out over it?

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: On what were its pillars based, or who put down its angle-stone,

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: When the morning stars made songs together, and all the sons of the gods gave cries of joy?

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: Or where were you when the sea came to birth, pushing out from its secret place;

entries.title: Job 38:9
segments: When I made the cloud its robe, and put thick clouds as bands round it,

entries.title: Job 38:10
segments: Ordering a fixed limit for it, with locks and doors;

entries.title: Job 38:11
segments: And said, So far you may come, and no farther; and here the pride of your waves will be stopped?

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: ¶Have you, from your earliest days, given orders to the morning, or made the dawn conscious of its place;

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments: So that it might take a grip of the skirts of the earth, shaking all the evil-doers out of it?

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments: It is changed like wet earth under a stamp, and is coloured like a robe;

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: And from the evil-doers their light is kept back, and the arm of pride is broken.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: Have you come into the springs of the sea, walking in the secret places of the deep?

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: Have the doors of death been open to you, or have the door-keepers of the dark ever seen you?

entries.title: Job 38:18
segments: Have you taken note of the wide limits of the earth? Say, if you have knowledge of it all.

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: Which is the way to the resting-place of the light, and where is the store-house of the dark;

entries.title: Job 38:20
segments: So that you might take it to its limit, guiding it to its house?

entries.title: Job 38:21
segments: No doubt you have knowledge of it, for then you had come to birth, and the number of your days is great.

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: Have you come into the secret place of snow, or have you seen the store-houses of the ice-drops,

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: Which I have kept for the time of trouble, for the day of war and fighting?

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: Which is the way to the place where the wind is measured out, and the east wind sent out over the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: ¶By whom has the way been cut for the flowing of the rain, and the flaming of the thunder;

entries.title: Job 38:26
segments: Causing rain to come on a land where no man is living, on the waste land which has no people;

entries.title: Job 38:27
segments: To give water to the land where there is waste and destruction, and to make the dry land green with young grass?

entries.title: Job 38:28
segments: Has the rain a father? or who gave birth to the drops of night mist?

entries.title: Job 38:29
segments: Out of whose body came the ice? and who gave birth to the cold mist of heaven?

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: The waters are joined together, hard as a stone, and the face of the deep is covered.

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments: Are the bands of the Pleiades fixed by you, or are the cords of Orion made loose?

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments: Do you make Mazzaroth come out in its right time, or are the Bear and its children guided by you?

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments: Have you knowledge of the laws of the heavens? did you give them rule over the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:34
segments: Is your voice sent up to the cloud, so that you may be covered by the weight of waters?

entries.title: Job 38:35
segments: Do you send out the thunder-flames, so that they may go, and say to you, Here we are?

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: Who has put wisdom in the high clouds, or given knowledge to the lights of the north?

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: By whose wisdom are the clouds numbered, or the water-skins of the heavens turned to the earth,

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: When the earth becomes hard as metal, and is joined together in masses?

entries.title: Job 38:39
segments: Do you go after food for the she-lion, or get meat so that the young lions may have enough,

entries.title: Job 38:40
segments: When they are stretched out in their holes, and are waiting in the brushwood?

entries.title: Job 38:41
segments: Who gives in the evening the meat he is searching for, when his young ones are crying to God; when the young lions with loud noise go wandering after their food?
